title: Sub-Gaussian absolute tail bound
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, let $Y:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ have sub-Gaussian moment-generating function with parameter $1$, and let $t\ge 0$. Then $\mu(\{\omega: t\le |Y(\omega)|\})\le 2\exp(-t^2/2)$.
hypotheses_covered: $Y:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ has sub-Gaussian moment-generating function with parameter $1$
